proof.text: Write $Q:D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)\to D^b_c(X,E)$ for the scalar localization and transport the given lattice along $\alpha$, so $Q(K_{\mathcal O})\simeq K_E$. The rational truncations of [prop-constructible-truncations] are induced by the standard truncations of integral representatives, so $Q(\mathcal H^j(K_{\mathcal O}))\simeq\mathcal H^j(K_E)=0$ for $j\neq0$, because $K_E$ is in the heart. In the scalar localization an object is zero exactly when $\varpi^N$ kills its identity for some $N$ (the identity maps to $\mathrm{id}\otimes1=0$ in $\operatorname{Hom}\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$). So each $\mathcal H^j(K_{\mathcal O})$, $j\ne0$, is killed by a power of $\varpi$. By [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization] (ii)$\Leftrightarrow$(iii), which describes exactly the category of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] over the noetherian finite-dimensional scheme $X$, there is a finite stratification such that on each stratum $C=\mathcal H^0(K_{\mathcal O})$ is pro-etale locally $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}N$ with $N$ finitely presented. Finitely many such local pieces cover each quasi-compact stratum. On a piece with $N\simeq\mathcal O_E^r\oplus\bigoplus_i\mathcal O_E/\varpi^{e_i}$, the $\varpi$-power torsion is $\bigoplus_i\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}/\varpi^{e_i}$, since the completed coefficient sheaf is $\varpi$-torsion-free. Kernels and unions are formed locally, so a common exponent $e$ gives $\varpi^eD=0$ and $D=\ker(\varpi^e:C\to C)$. The characterization is closed under cones and under cohomology sheaves placed in degree zero. Hence $D$, the $\mathcal H^{-1}$ of the cone of $\varpi^e$, and $M=C/D$, the $\mathcal H^0$ of the cone of $D\hookrightarrow C$, lie in the integral category. Locally $M\simeq\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_E^r$, so $\varpi$ is injective on $M$.

proof.text: The cones of the canonical maps $\tau^{\le0}K_{\mathcal O}\to K_{\mathcal O}$ and $\tau^{\le0}K_{\mathcal O}\to\mathcal H^0(K_{\mathcal O})=C$ have finitely many nonzero cohomology sheaves, each killed by a power of $\varpi$ (Step 1). The cone of $C\to M$ is $D[1]$, killed by $\varpi^e$. If $Z'\to Z\to Z''\to$ is a triangle with $\varpi^a\mathrm{id}_{Z'}=0$ and $\varpi^b\mathrm{id}_{Z''}=0$, then $\varpi^b\mathrm{id}_Z$ factors through $Z'$, so $\varpi^{a+b}\mathrm{id}_Z=0$. Induction over the truncation triangles of [prop-constructible-truncations] shows that each cone has its identity killed by a power of $\varpi$. Each cone is therefore zero in the exact scalar localization of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], so the three maps become isomorphisms there. Composing with $\alpha$ gives a specified isomorphism $K_E\simeq Q(K_{\mathcal O})\simeq Q(M)=M[1/\varpi]$. [lem-weil-compact-support-representative-independence] for $f=a_X$ turns it into an isomorphism $(Ra_{X!}K_E)\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}E\simeq(Ra_{X!}M)\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}E$ of the rational compact-support objects of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Taking point sections and cohomology, and using that $E$ is flat over $\mathcal O_E$, gives $H_c^i(X,K_E)\simeq H^i(R\Gamma_c(X,M))\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$.

Since $\varpi$ is injective on $M$, the two-term resolution $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}\xrightarrow{\varpi^n}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}$ of $(A_n)_X$ shows that the derived reduction is the ordinary quotient $M_n=M/\varpi^nM$, concentrated in degree zero. By Step 1, $M$ is an object of the derived-complete integral category of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], so each $M_n$ is a bounded finite-torsion constructible complex. Apply [lem-coef-integral-residue-tor] to $M$ with $[a,b]=[0,0]$: every $M_n$ has Tor amplitude in $[0,0]$, so $M_n\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A_n)$. Each $M_n$ is a constructible sheaf in degree zero over the finite ring $A_n$. [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin] therefore supplies a pair $(L_n,\alpha_n)$, with $L_n$ a bounded constructible etale complex and $\alpha_n:\nu_X^*L_n\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n$, which is an explicit etale-origin witness in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. The transitions are the quotient maps $M/\varpi^{n+1}M\to M/\varpi^nM$. The induced maps $M_n\otimes^L_{A_n}A_j\to M_j$ are the identifications $(M\otimes^L\widehat{\mathcal O}/\varpi^n)\otimes^L_{A_n}A_j\simeq M\otimes^L\widehat{\mathcal O}/\varpi^j$ given by associativity of the derived tensor product, so they are isomorphisms. This gives the normalized $A_\bullet$-system of [def-trf-adic-system].

By Step 3, $(M_n)_n$ is the reduction tower of the integral object $M$ and a normalized $A_\bullet$-system, which is the hypothesis of [prop-trf-adic-coefficient-morphism-systems]. That proposition assumes no Weil structure and no coefficient morphism for its clauses (1) and (2). Its statement identifies the derived limit $P_{\mathcal O}$ of the tower $P_n=R\Gamma_c(X,M_n)$ with $R\Gamma_c(X,M)$ of [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], applied to $a_X:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. Clause (2) then says that $P=R\Gamma_c(X,M)$ is represented by a bounded complex of finite free $\mathcal O_E$-modules, and that the canonical maps $\pi_n:P\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_n\to R\Gamma_c(X,M_n)$ are isomorphisms for every $n\ge1$. Only clauses (1) and (2), the perfectness and integral-realization assertions, are used.

title: Integral lattice and finite-free compact-support model on a curve
statement:
Fix the global finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$ and $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$. Let $X_0$ be separated of finite type over $k_0$ with $\dim X_0\le1$, and put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$. The integral category and its rationalization are [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Let $K_E\in D^b_c(X,E)$ be an object which is a sheaf in degree zero for the standard pair of [def-weil-constructible-standard-tstructure] (no Weil structure is used), and let $K_{\mathcal O}\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ together with an isomorphism $\alpha:K_{\mathcal O}\xrightarrow{\sim}K_E$ of $D^b_c(X,E)$ be any integral lattice of $K_E$ (when $K_E$ is presented by an integral object, take that chosen integral representative together with its specified localization isomorphism $\alpha$). No finite-level hypothesis (etale-origin witness or admissibility) is assumed for the reductions of $K_{\mathcal O}$. Set $C=\mathcal H^0(K_{\mathcal O})$, $D=\bigcup_{n\ge1}\ker(\varpi^n:C\to C)$ and $M=C/D$, regarded as sheaves of modules over the completed coefficient sheaf of [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Then $D$ is killed by a single power of $\varpi$, $M$ is a constructible integral sheaf on which multiplication by $\varpi$ is injective, and $K_E\simeq M[1/\varpi]$ in $D^b_c(X,E)$. The derived reductions of $M$ are the underived sheaves $M_n=M/\varpi^nM$, they lie in $D^b_{ctf}(X,A_n)$ and admit explicit etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], and their quotient-induced transitions form a normalized system [def-trf-adic-system]. Moreover, for the compact-support functor [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], $P=R\Gamma_c(X,M)$ is represented by a bounded complex of finite free $\mathcal O_E$-modules, with
$$P\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_n\simeq R\Gamma_c(X,M_n),\qquad H_c^i(X,K_E)\simeq H^i(P)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E\quad(n\ge1,\ i\in\mathbf Z).$$
No Weil structure on $M$ is asserted.
